Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for IPv6 RA Guard：Assets, trust boundaries and test fixtures: Map 24 access ports and two authorized router ports; test RA, NS/NA and required error notifications per port instead of blocking all ICMPv6. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Map 24 access ports and two authorized router ports; test RA, NS/NA and required error notifications per port instead of blocking all ICMPv6. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。畫出24個接入埠與2個授權路由器埠；逐埠測RA、NS/NA與必要錯誤通知，不使用「全部封鎖ICMPv6」代替設計。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Map 24 access ports and two authorized router ports; test RA, NS/NA and required error notifications per port instead of blocking all ICMPv6. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 畫出24個接入埠與2個授權路由器埠；逐埠測RA、NS/NA與必要錯誤通知，不使用「全部封鎖ICMPv6」代替設計。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.checkEn: Map 24 access ports and two authorized router ports; test RA, NS/NA and required error notifications per port instead of blocking all ICMPv6. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: IPv6網路安全需處理鄰居探索、路由器公告與ICMPv6；RA Guard是接入層的一種控制。
knowledge.textEn: IPv6 security includes neighbor discovery, router advertisements and ICMPv6; RA Guard is one access-layer control.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 畫出24個接入埠與2個授權路由器埠；逐埠測RA、NS/NA與必要錯誤通知，不使用「全部封鎖ICMPv6」代替設計。
knowledge.textEn: Map 24 access ports and two authorized router ports; test RA, NS/NA and required error notifications per port instead of blocking all ICMPv6.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 端口測試數=(接入埠+路由器埠)×封包類別數；允許RA的埠與允許鄰居探索的埠集合不相同。
knowledge.textEn: Port tests equal (access+router ports)×packet classes; ports allowed to send RA are not the same set as ports needing neighbor discovery.
